mentions.h: McDonalds Young Athletes League Boys Southern Premier Division: Bels make it to the National Finals
mentions.note: 3rd and 4th in Under 13 National Rankings for 100m (12.3) and 200m (26.0), aged eleven

photos.c: Sean Eaton ran to 3rd and 4th places in the Under 13 National Rankings for 100 and 200 metres with 12.3 and 26.0, times set when he was still eleven years of age. With another summer in the age group we can expect fireworks from this boy in 1997- but then with an Aunt like GB international Lorna Booth would you expect otherwise.
